title: A survey of US adults: 75% say they have heard a lot or a little about data centers; 39% say they are bad for the environment, and 38% bad for home energy costs (Pew Research Center)
summary: Pew Research Center: A survey of US adults: 75% say they have heard a lot or a little about data centers; 39% say they are bad for the environment, and 38% bad for home energy costs — A broad majority of Americans have heard about data centers - the often-sprawling computing facilities that are popping up nationwide.
